intent: Three target identities and topology are fixed before control dispatch and supplied separately to the consumer. controller-to-A/B/C fan-out and controller-to-A-to-B-to-C chain are different experiments. The chain has three delivery links and two inter-target delegation links.
attempts: execution attempt_id is stable for each target obligation. delivery_attempt_id identifies each transport attempt. A lost response may coexist with receiver receipt and pause. Retries retain failed transport attempts, never enlarge the target denominator, and must not re-execute the accepted pause.
causality: Each process has its own monotonic clock. Exact request/reply bytes, sender/recipient, parent delivery attempt and route path bind hops. Clocks from different processes are never numerically compared.
observation: The author-controlled harness samples append-only business files twice after control responses. Equal endpoints report only bounded quiescence; unknown/refused targets remain visible, and cleanup does not generate control success.
coverage: Enumerated intended-target accounting is local only. Native reconciliation and intended_target_coverage NOT_EVALUATED remain visible, unchanged. Enumerating three targets is not proof of all possible execution paths or complete native lifecycle evidence.

covers: First-party bounded three-target and delegation mapping under local-multitarget-delegation-v1
does_not_cover: Independent event truth or observer independence
Permanent stop, causal enforcement or complete execution-path coverage
Production SDK or A2A/AgentProto protocol interoperability
Native Control/Execution/Effect lifecycle completeness or native target coverage
Sandbox protection, hostile-process isolation or distributed-host behavior

limits: Author-operated same-host Unix-domain socket experiments; each target uses a separate LangGraph process and signing key.
Harness and workers share a host account. Unlike T14, this module does not sandbox workers or claim protected observer storage.
Signatures authenticate supplied reports; event truth and controller-selected identities/trust remain author-dependent.
Endpoint file samples are not continuous observation, permanent stop or enforcement proof. Cleanup remains separate.
Fixed intended targets do not establish all possible execution paths. Native NOT_EVALUATED is not upgraded by local accounting.
No production SDK, public release, external adoption, multi-host, A2A implementation or IETF conformance claim.
